protocol.primaryStatistic: arithmetic mean of all retained build samples
protocol.uncertainty: paired process-round bootstrap of ratio of arithmetic means; resample complete layer triplets with fixed seed
protocol.outlierPolicy: retain every timed sample after the predefined first-build warmup
protocol.baselineRunPolicy: report the earlier six rounds separately; combined thirty-round results are a sensitivity analysis

bootstrap.method: paired complete-round percentile bootstrap for percent reduction in arithmetic mean; includes all post-warmup observations
bootstrap.limitations: Does not model serial dependence between rounds or prove causation for uncontrolled background activity.
